    """Conformance validator for datasets.yaml, datasets.lock.yaml and datapackage.json.

Checks run over plain dicts in the new key form (see ``aliases.py``). Each
check is registered on its rule in ``rules.RULES`` and yields ``Violation``s.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import re
import warnings
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from . import STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES
from .aliases import MIN_NEW_FORM_VERSION, Rename, is_doi_url, normalize_document, normalize_lock, version_key
from .rules import RULES, Level, Severity, register_check, severity_for
from .vocab import (
    SHIPPED_VOCABS,
    config_keys,
    dp_keys,
    duplicate_keys,
    legacy_emitted_keys,
    level_children,
    lock_keys,
    namespace_of,
    recommended_keys,
    term_exists,
)

ENFORCE_MUST = False
"""False in 1.x (MUST violations warn), True in 2.0 (they raise ConformanceError)."""


class ConformanceError(Exception):
    """Raised on read/write for MUST violations when ``ENFORCE_MUST`` is True."""


@dataclass
class Violation:
    rule_id: str
    level: Level
    path: str
    message: str
    fix: Optional[str]
    severity: Severity

    @property
    def location(self) -> str:
        return self.path

    @property
    def fix_hint(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.fix

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "rule_id": self.rule_id,
            "level": self.level.value,
            "severity": self.severity.value,
            "path": self.path,
            "message": self.message,
            "fix": self.fix,
            "location": self.path,
            "fix_hint": self.fix,
        }


Kind = Literal["yaml", "lock", "datapackage"]


@dataclass
class ConformanceContext:
    kind: Kind
    data: Mapping[str, Any]
    lock: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    renames: list[Rename] = field(default_factory=list)
    ambiguous: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    prefixes: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    field_types: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
    new_form: bool = False
    """The yaml document used new-form keys before normalization (R306)."""

    def violation(self, rule_id: str, path: str, message: str, fix: Optional[str] = None) -> Violation:
        rule = RULES[rule_id]
        return Violation(rule_id, rule.level, path, message, fix or rule.fix, severity_for(rule, ENFORCE_MUST))

    def datasets(self) -> Iterator[tuple[str, int, Mapping[str, Any], str]]:
        for section, kind in (("inputs", "input"), ("outputs", "output")):
            items = self.data.get(section)
            if not isinstance(items, list):
                continue
            for i, ds in enumerate(items):
                if isinstance(ds, Mapping):
                    yield kind, i, ds, f"{section}[{i}]"

    def dataset_names(self) -> set[str]:
        return {str(ds.get("name")) for _, _, ds, _ in self.datasets() if ds.get("name")}

    def lock_entry(self, name: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
        for entry in self.lock.get("outputs") or []:
            if isinstance(entry, Mapping) and entry.get("slug") == name:
                return entry
        return {}

    def locked_units(self, name: Any) -> set[str]:
        units: set[str] = set()
        for section in ("inputs", "outputs"):
            for entry in self.lock.get(section) or []:
                if isinstance(entry, Mapping) and entry.get("slug") == name:
                    for fld in entry.get("fields") or []:
                        if isinstance(fld, Mapping) and fld.get("name") and (fld.get("unit") or fld.get("si:unit")):
                            units.add(str(fld["name"]))
        return units

    def packages(self) -> Iterator[tuple[Mapping[str, Any], str, bool]]:
        """Yield (package dict, path, publish enabled)."""
        pkg = self.data.get("package")
        if isinstance(pkg, Mapping):
            yield pkg, "package", _publish_enabled(self.data.get("publish"))
        pkgs = self.data.get("packages")
        if isinstance(pkgs, list):
            for i, p in enumerate(pkgs):
                if isinstance(p, Mapping):
                    yield p, f"packages[{i}]", _publish_enabled(p.get("publish"))

    def is_published(self, ds: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
        if "publish" in ds:
            return _publish_enabled(ds.get("publish"))
        for pkg, _, enabled in self.packages():
            datasets = pkg.get("datasets")
            if enabled and isinstance(datasets, list) and ds.get("name") in datasets:
                return True
        return "packages" not in self.data and _publish_enabled(self.data.get("publish"))

    def is_publishing(self) -> bool:
        """True when ``publish`` is enabled at the top level or on any ``packages[]`` entry (spec: Methodology MUST)."""
        if _publish_enabled(self.data.get("publish")):
            return True
        return any(enabled for _, _, enabled in self.packages())

    def package_license_for(self, name: Any) -> tuple[Any, str]:
        for pkg, path, _ in self.packages():
            datasets = pkg.get("datasets")
            covers = datasets is None or (isinstance(datasets, list) and name in datasets)
            lic = _first_license(pkg.get("licenses"))
            if covers and lic:
                return lic, f"{path}.licenses"
        return None, "package.licenses"


def _publish_enabled(raw: Any) -> bool:
    if isinstance(raw, bool):
        return raw
    if isinstance(raw, Mapping):
        return bool(raw.get("enabled"))
    return False


def _first_license(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, list) and value and isinstance(value[0], Mapping):
        return value[0].get("name")
    return None


_ARRAY_RE = re.compile(r"\[\d+\]")
_CAMEL_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])")


def split_camel(name: str) -> str:
    return _CAMEL_RE.sub(" ", name).replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ").lower()


def _is_rdf_key(key: str) -> bool:
    return key.startswith(("http://", "https://")) or ":" in key


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Extras: R301 / R302 / R303 / R304 / R305
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #


def _check_key(ctx: ConformanceContext, key: str, level: str, path: str) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    kpath = f"{path}.{key}" if path else key
    if key in ("@id", "@type"):
        return
    if ctx.kind == "yaml" and key in config_keys(level):
        return
    if ctx.kind == "lock":
        if key in lock_keys(level):
            return
    elif level != "node" and key in dp_keys(level):
        return
    if ctx.kind == "datapackage" and not ENFORCE_MUST and key in legacy_emitted_keys(level):
        return
    if key.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        for prefix in SHIPPED_VOCABS:
            ns = namespace_of(prefix)
            if key.startswith(ns):
                local = key[len(ns) :]
                if not term_exists(prefix, local):
                    yield ctx.violation("R303", kpath, f"'{prefix}:{local}' is not a term in the {prefix} vocabulary")
                return
        return
    if ":" in key:
        prefix, local = key.split(":", 1)
        if prefix not in ctx.prefixes:
            yield ctx.violation("R302", kpath, f"prefix '{prefix}' is not declared")
        elif prefix in SHIPPED_VOCABS and not term_exists(prefix, local):
            yield ctx.violation("R303", kpath, f"'{key}' is not a term in the {prefix} vocabulary")
        return
    at = _ARRAY_RE.sub("", path)
    yield ctx.violation(
        "R301",
        kpath,
        f"unknown key '{key}' at level '{level}'",
        f'Run `sunstone vocab search "{split_camel(key)}" --at {at or "."}` and use a listed key.',
    )


def _walk(ctx: ConformanceContext, m: Mapping[str, Any], level: str, path: str) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    children = level_children(level)
    for key, value in m.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str):
            continue
        yield from _check_key(ctx, key, level, path)
        kpath = f"{path}.{key}" if path else key
        child = children.get(key)
        if child is not None:
            if isinstance(value, list):
                for i, item in enumerate(value):
                    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                        yield from _walk(ctx, item, child, f"{kpath}[{i}]")
            elif isinstance(value, Mapping):
                yield from _walk(ctx, value, child, kpath)
        elif _is_rdf_key(key):
            if isinstance(value, Mapping):
                yield from _walk(ctx, value, "node", kpath)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for i, item in enumerate(value):
                    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                        yield from _walk(ctx, item, "node", f"{kpath}[{i}]")


@register_check("R301")
def _r301(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        yield from (v for v in _walk(ctx, ctx.data, "document", "") if v.rule_id == "R301")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        yield from (v for v in _walk(ctx, ctx.data, "package", "") if v.rule_id == "R301")
    else:
        yield from (v for v in _walk_lock(ctx) if v.rule_id == "R301")


@register_check("R302")
def _r302(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    yield from (v for v in _all_key_violations(ctx) if v.rule_id == "R302")


@register_check("R303")
def _r303(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    yield from (v for v in _all_key_violations(ctx) if v.rule_id == "R303")


def _all_key_violations(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        yield from _walk(ctx, ctx.data, "document", "")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        yield from _walk(ctx, ctx.data, "package", "")
    else:
        yield from _walk_lock(ctx)


def _walk_lock(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    for section in ("inputs", "outputs"):
        for i, entry in enumerate(ctx.lock.get(section) or []):
            if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
                continue
            path = f"{section}[{i}]"
            for key in entry:
                if isinstance(key, str):
                    yield from _check_key(ctx, key, "entry", path)
            for j, src in enumerate(entry.get("sources") or []):
                if isinstance(src, Mapping):
                    for key in src:
                        if isinstance(key, str):
                            yield from _check_key(ctx, key, "source", f"{path}.sources[{j}]")


@register_check("R304")
def _r304(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    for r in ctx.renames:
        path = f"{r.path}.{r.old}" if r.path else r.old
        yield ctx.violation("R304", path, f"deprecated key '{r.old}', use '{r.new}'")


@register_check("R305")
def _r305(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    for path in ctx.ambiguous:
        yield ctx.violation("R305", path, "entry has both 'slug' and 'title'")


@register_check("R306")
def _r306(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind != "yaml" or not ctx.new_form:
        return
    raw = ctx.data.get("min_sunstone_version")
    if raw is None or version_key(str(raw)) < version_key(MIN_NEW_FORM_VERSION):
        found = "missing" if raw is None else f"found {raw!r}"
        yield ctx.violation("R306", "min_sunstone_version", f"new-form keys need min_sunstone_version >= {MIN_NEW_FORM_VERSION} ({found})")


def _duplicates(ctx: ConformanceContext, m: Mapping[str, Any], level: str, path: str) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    for key, instead in duplicate_keys(level).items():
        if key in m:
            yield ctx.violation("R307", f"{path}.{key}", f"'{key}' duplicates '{instead}'", f"Remove '{key}'; use {instead}.")


@register_check("R307")
def _r307(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind != "yaml":
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        yield from _duplicates(ctx, ds, "dataset", path)
        if kind == "output":
            yield from _duplicates(ctx, ds, "output", path)
        src = ds.get("source")
        if isinstance(src, Mapping):
            yield from _duplicates(ctx, src, "source", f"{path}.source")
    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        yield from _duplicates(ctx, fld, "field", path)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Naming / description / types / units (R001–R008, R103–R105, R201, R202, R331, R341, R351)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$")
GENERIC_FIELD_NAMES = frozenset({"total", "value", "count", "data", "amount", "number", "n", "x", "y", "z"})
GENERIC_DATASET_TITLES = frozenset({"data", "output", "results", "result", "input"})
NUMERIC_FIELD_TYPES = frozenset({"integer", "number"})


def _yaml_only(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> bool:
    return ctx.kind == "yaml"


def _resources(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[tuple[Mapping[str, Any], str]]:
    for i, r in enumerate(ctx.data.get("resources") or []):
        if isinstance(r, Mapping):
            yield r, f"resources[{i}]"


@register_check("R001")
def _r001(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
            if not ds.get("title") and path not in ctx.ambiguous:
                yield ctx.violation("R001", path, "missing 'title'")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        for r, path in _resources(ctx):
            if not r.get("title"):
                yield ctx.violation("R001", path, "missing 'title'")


@register_check("R002")
def _r002(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
            if not ds.get("name"):
                yield ctx.violation("R002", path, "missing 'name'")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        for r, path in _resources(ctx):
            if not r.get("name"):
                yield ctx.violation("R002", path, "missing 'name'")


@register_check("R003")
def _r003(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if not ds.get("path"):
            yield ctx.violation("R003", path, "missing 'path'")


@register_check("R004")
def _r004(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if not ds.get("description"):
            yield ctx.violation("R004", path, "missing 'description'")


ALLOWED_LICENSES = frozenset(
    {
        "CC0-1.0", "CC-BY-4.0", "CC-BY-3.0", "CC-BY-3.0-IGO", "CC-BY-SA-4.0", "CC-BY-SA-3.0", "CC-BY-NC-4.0",
        "CC-BY-NC-3.0", "CC-BY-NC-3.0-IGO", "CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0", "CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0", "CC-BY-ND-4.0", "MIT", "Apache-2.0",
        "BSD-2-Clause", "BSD-3-Clause", "GPL-2.0-only", "GPL-2.0-or-later", "GPL-3.0-only", "GPL-3.0-or-later",
        "LGPL-3.0-only", "LGPL-3.0-or-later", "MPL-2.0", "ODbL-1.0", "ODC-By-1.0", "PDDL-1.0", "Unlicense",
        "public-domain", "proprietary",
    }
)


def _license_of(ctx: ConformanceContext, kind: str, ds: Mapping[str, Any], path: str) -> tuple[Any, str]:
    if kind == "input":
        src = ds.get("source")
        if isinstance(src, Mapping):
            return src.get("dct:license"), f"{path}.source.dct:license"
        return None, f"{path}.source.dct:license"
    own = _first_license(ds.get("licenses"))
    if own:
        return own, f"{path}.licenses"
    return ctx.package_license_for(ds.get("name"))


@register_check("R005")
def _r005(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        value, lpath = _license_of(ctx, kind, ds, path)
        if not value:
            yield ctx.violation("R005", lpath, "missing license")


@register_check("R006")
def _r006(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        value, lpath = _license_of(ctx, kind, ds, path)
        if value and value not in ALLOWED_LICENSES:
            yield ctx.violation("R006", lpath, f"license '{value}' is not a recognised identifier")


def _fields(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any], Mapping[str, Any], str]]:
    """Yield (dataset kind, dataset, field, field path) for yaml documents."""
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        schema = ds.get("schema")
        fields = schema.get("fields") if isinstance(schema, Mapping) else None
        if not isinstance(fields, list):
            continue
        for i, fld in enumerate(fields):
            if isinstance(fld, Mapping):
                yield kind, ds, fld, f"{path}.schema.fields[{i}]"


@register_check("R007")
def _r007(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        if not fld.get("name"):
            yield ctx.violation("R007", path, "field missing 'name'")


@register_check("R008")
def _r008(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        if not fld.get("type"):
            yield ctx.violation("R008", path, "field missing 'type'")


@register_check("R331")
def _r331(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        t = fld.get("type")
        if t and t not in ctx.field_types:
            yield ctx.violation("R331", f"{path}.type", f"unknown field type '{t}'", f"Use one of: {', '.join(sorted(ctx.field_types))}")


@register_check("R103")
def _r103(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, ds, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        if fld.get("type") in NUMERIC_FIELD_TYPES and not fld.get("si:unit") and fld.get("name") not in ctx.locked_units(ds.get("name")):
            yield ctx.violation("R103", path, f"numeric field '{fld.get('name')}' has no si:unit")


@register_check("R341")
def _r341(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    from .units import is_qudt_uri, try_parse_unit

    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        unit = fld.get("si:unit")
        if isinstance(unit, str) and unit and not is_qudt_uri(unit) and try_parse_unit(unit) is None:
            yield ctx.violation("R341", f"{path}.si:unit", f"unit '{unit}' is not a Pint unit or QUDT IRI")


@register_check("R105")
def _r105(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, ds, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        if kind == "output" and ctx.is_published(ds) and not str(fld.get("description") or "").strip():
            yield ctx.violation("R105", path, f"published field '{fld.get('name')}' has no description")


@register_check("R201")
def _r201(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, fld, path in _fields(ctx):
        name = fld.get("name")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name.lower() in GENERIC_FIELD_NAMES and len(str(fld.get("description") or "").strip()) < 10:
            yield ctx.violation("R201", path, f"generic field name '{name}' without a substantive description")


@register_check("R202")
def _r202(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        title = ds.get("title")
        if isinstance(title, str) and title.strip().lower() in GENERIC_DATASET_TITLES:
            yield ctx.violation("R202", f"{path}.title", f"generic dataset title '{title}'")


@register_check("R104")
def _r104(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        name = ds.get("name")
        if isinstance(name, str) and name and not NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(name):
            yield ctx.violation("R104", f"{path}.name", f"name '{name}' is not kebab-case")


@register_check("R351")
def _r351(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        for pkg, path, enabled in ctx.packages():
            if enabled and not pkg.get("title"):
                yield ctx.violation("R351", f"{path}.title", "package has no title but publishing is enabled")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage" and not ctx.data.get("title"):
        yield ctx.violation("R351", "title", "datapackage has no title")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Provenance (R101, R102, R311, R312, R313) and lineage (R321, R322, R323)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #


@register_check("R101")
def _r101(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if kind == "input" and "source" not in ds:
            yield ctx.violation("R101", f"{path}.source", "input has no 'source' block")


@register_check("R102")
def _r102(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if kind != "input" or "source" not in ds:
            continue
        src = ds.get("source")
        if not isinstance(src, Mapping):
            yield ctx.violation("R102", f"{path}.source", "source block must be a mapping")
            continue
        missing = [k for k in ("title", "dct:license") if not src.get(k)]
        publisher = src.get("dct:publisher")
        if not (isinstance(publisher, Mapping) and publisher.get("rdfs:label")):
            missing.append("dct:publisher with rdfs:label")
        if not (src.get("@id") or src.get("dcat:downloadURL") or src.get("dcat:landingPage")):
            missing.append('a link ("@id", dcat:downloadURL or dcat:landingPage)')
        if missing:
            yield ctx.violation("R102", f"{path}.source", f"source block missing keys: {', '.join(missing)}")


def _is_publication(src: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return bool(src.get("dct:isPartOf") or src.get("dct:bibliographicCitation"))


@register_check("R311")
def _r311(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        src = ds.get("source")
        if kind != "input" or not isinstance(src, Mapping):
            continue
        missing = []
        publisher = src.get("dct:publisher")
        if isinstance(publisher, Mapping) and not publisher.get("skos:altLabel"):
            missing.append("dct:publisher.skos:altLabel")
        missing += [k for k in ("dct:issued", "dct:modified") if not src.get(k)]
        if _is_publication(src):
            missing += [k for k in ("dct:creator", "@id") if not src.get(k)]
        if missing:
            yield ctx.violation("R311", f"{path}.source", f"source block missing recommended keys: {', '.join(missing)}")


def _doi_in_links(ctx: ConformanceContext, src: Mapping[str, Any], path: str, keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    for key in keys:
        value = src.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, str) and is_doi_url(value):
            yield ctx.violation("R315", f"{path}.{key}", f"'{key}' holds a DOI ({value}); put it in \"@id\"")


@register_check("R315")
def _r315(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
            src = ds.get("source")
            if isinstance(src, Mapping):
                yield from _doi_in_links(ctx, src, f"{path}.source", ("dcat:downloadURL", "dcat:landingPage"))
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        dcat = STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES["dcat"]
        for r, path in _resources(ctx):
            for j, src in enumerate(r.get("sources") or []):
                if isinstance(src, Mapping):
                    yield from _doi_in_links(ctx, src, f"{path}.sources[{j}]", (f"{dcat}downloadURL", f"{dcat}landingPage"))


@register_check("R312")
def _r312(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if kind != "input":
            continue
        missing = []
        if not ds.get("prov:generatedAtTime"):
            missing.append("prov:generatedAtTime")
        gen = ds.get("prov:wasGeneratedBy")
        if not (isinstance(gen, Mapping) and gen.get("dct:type")):
            missing.append("prov:wasGeneratedBy.dct:type")
        if missing:
            yield ctx.violation("R312", path, f"input missing {', '.join(missing)}")


@register_check("R313")
def _r313(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml":
        for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
            if kind == "output" and ctx.is_published(ds) and "source" not in ds and not ctx.lock_entry(ds.get("name")).get("sources"):
                yield ctx.violation("R313", path, "published output has no source and no lock-file sources")
    elif ctx.kind == "datapackage":
        for r, path in _resources(ctx):
            if not r.get("sources"):
                yield ctx.violation("R313", f"{path}.sources", "resource has no sources")


@register_check("R314")
def _r314(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    should = [k for k, lvl in recommended_keys("dataset").items() if lvl == "SHOULD"]
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if kind == "output" and ctx.is_published(ds):
            missing = [k for k in should if not ds.get(k)]
            if missing:
                yield ctx.violation("R314", path, f"published output missing recommended {', '.join(missing)}")


@register_check("R361")
def _r361(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml" and not ctx.is_publishing() and not ctx.data.get("dcat-si:methodology"):
        yield ctx.violation("R361", "dcat-si:methodology", "no methodology document declared")


@register_check("R362")
def _r362(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind == "yaml" and ctx.is_publishing() and not ctx.data.get("dcat-si:methodology"):
        yield ctx.violation("R362", "dcat-si:methodology", "project publishes a package but declares no methodology document")


@register_check("R321")
def _r321(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for kind, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if kind != "output":
            continue
        entry = ctx.lock_entry(ds.get("name"))
        if not (entry.get("sources") and entry.get("activity")):
            yield ctx.violation("R321", path, "output has no lock entry with sources and activity")


@register_check("R322")
def _r322(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if ctx.kind != "lock":
        return
    names = ctx.dataset_names()
    for i, entry in enumerate(ctx.lock.get("outputs") or []):
        if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
            continue
        for j, src in enumerate(entry.get("sources") or []):
            slug = src.get("slug") if isinstance(src, Mapping) else src
            if slug not in names:
                yield ctx.violation("R322", f"outputs[{i}].sources[{j}].slug", f"lock source '{slug}' is not a registered dataset")


@register_check("R323")
def _r323(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> Iterator[Violation]:
    if not _yaml_only(ctx):
        return
    for _, _, ds, path in ctx.datasets():
        if "lineage" in ds:
            yield ctx.violation("R323", f"{path}.lineage", "inline lineage in datasets.yaml")

KEY_LEVELS: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[Level, Optional[str]]] = {
    ("document", "min_sunstone_version"): (Level.MUST, "R306"),
    ("document", "dcat-si:methodology"): (Level.SHOULD, "R361"),
    ("dataset", "title"): (Level.MUST, "R001"),
    ("dataset", "name"): (Level.MUST, "R002"),
    ("dataset", "path"): (Level.MUST, "R003"),
    ("dataset", "description"): (Level.SHOULD, "R004"),
    ("dataset", "licenses"): (Level.MUST, "R005"),
    ("dataset", "source"): (Level.SHOULD, "R101"),
    ("dataset", "prov:generatedAtTime"): (Level.MUST, "R312"),
    ("dataset", "prov:wasGeneratedBy"): (Level.MUST, "R312"),
    ("source", "title"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "dct:publisher"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "@id"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "dcat:downloadURL"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "dcat:landingPage"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "dct:license"): (Level.MUST, "R102"),
    ("source", "dct:issued"): (Level.SHOULD, "R311"),
    ("source", "dct:modified"): (Level.SHOULD, "R311"),
    ("source", "dct:creator"): (Level.SHOULD, "R311"),
    ("source", "dct:isPartOf"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("source", "dct:bibliographicCitation"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("source", "prov:wasAttributedTo"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("source", "dcat:accessURL"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("source", "rdfs:seeAlso"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("source", "version"): (Level.MAY, None),
    ("field", "name"): (Level.MUST, "R007"),
    ("field", "type"): (Level.MUST, "R008"),
    ("field", "description"): (Level.SHOULD, "R105"),
    ("field", "si:unit"): (Level.SHOULD, "R103"),
    ("package", "title"): (Level.MUST, "R351"),
    ("package", "licenses"): (Level.MUST, "R005"),
}
"""Keys with a presence rule, for ``vocab search --at`` and the reference doc.

The three source links (``@id``, ``dcat:downloadURL``, ``dcat:landingPage``) are alternatives: R102 asks for one of them.
"""

# Spec "Recommended properties": SHOULD rows are checked by R314 (dataset level), MAY rows are listed only.
for _level in ("dataset", "source", "field"):
    for _key, _rfc in recommended_keys(_level).items():
        KEY_LEVELS.setdefault((_level, _key), (Level[_rfc], "R314" if _rfc == "SHOULD" else None))


def run_checks(ctx: ConformanceContext) -> list[Violation]:
    out: list[Violation] = []
    for rule in RULES.values():
        if rule.check is None or not any(s.startswith(ctx.kind + ":") for s in rule.scope):
            continue
        out.extend(rule.check(ctx))
    return out


def _collect_prefixes(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
    prefixes = dict(STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES)
    defaults = data.get("defaults")
    for block in (data.get("rdfPrefixes"), defaults.get("rdfPrefixes") if isinstance(defaults, Mapping) else None):
        if isinstance(block, Mapping):
            prefixes.update({str(k): str(v) for k, v in block.items()})
    for section in ("inputs", "outputs"):
        for ds in data.get(section) or []:
            block = ds.get("rdfPrefixes") if isinstance(ds, Mapping) else None
            if isinstance(block, Mapping):
                prefixes.update({str(k): str(v) for k, v in block.items()})
    return prefixes


def _default_field_types() -> frozenset[str]:
    from .field_types import FieldTypeRegistry

    return frozenset(FieldTypeRegistry().known())


def validate_datasets_yaml(
    data: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    lock: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    field_types: Optional[Any] = None,
    normalize: bool = True,
    result: Any = None,
) -> list[Violation]:
    """Validate a datasets.yaml document.

    With ``normalize=True`` (default) the document is deep-copied and alias
    keys are normalized first; ``data`` is never mutated. Pass
    ``normalize=False`` with the ``NormalizeResult`` from an earlier
    ``normalize_document`` call when the caller already normalized in place.
    """
    if normalize:
        data = copy.deepcopy(data)
        result = normalize_document(data)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    renames = list(result.renames) if result is not None else []
    ambiguous = list(result.ambiguous) if result is not None else []
    ctx = ConformanceContext(
        kind="yaml",
        data=data,
        lock=lock or {},
        renames=renames,
        ambiguous=ambiguous,
        prefixes=_collect_prefixes(data),
        field_types=frozenset(field_types) if field_types is not None else _default_field_types(),
        new_form=bool(result.new_form) if result is not None else False,
    )
    return run_checks(ctx)


def validate_lock(
    lock: Mapping[str, Any],
    data: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    normalize: bool = True,
    result: Any = None,
) -> list[Violation]:
    """Validate datasets.lock.yaml against the (normalized) datasets.yaml document."""
    if normalize:
        lock = copy.deepcopy(lock)
        result = normalize_lock(lock)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    ctx = ConformanceContext(
        kind="lock",
        data=data,
        lock=lock,
        renames=list(result.renames) if result is not None else [],
        prefixes=_collect_prefixes(data),
    )
    return run_checks(ctx)


def validate_datapackage(descriptor: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[Violation]:
    """Validate a finished datapackage.json descriptor (keys are expanded IRIs)."""
    ctx = ConformanceContext(kind="datapackage", data=descriptor, prefixes=dict(STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES))
    return run_checks(ctx)


SHOWN_IN_WARNING = 5
"""How many MUST violations the per-file FutureWarning lists (spec C4)."""


def enforce(violations: list[Violation], *, where: str, stacklevel: int = 3) -> None:
    """Apply the release policy to MUST violations: one FutureWarning per file in 1.x, ConformanceError in 2.0.

    FutureWarning, not DeprecationWarning: Python hides DeprecationWarning raised inside a library.
    """
    must = [v for v in violations if v.level in (Level.MUST, Level.MUST_NOT)]
    if not must:
        return
    if ENFORCE_MUST:
        lines = [f"[{v.rule_id}] {v.path}: {v.message}" for v in must]
        raise ConformanceError(f"{where}: " + "; ".join(lines))
    aliases = [v for v in must if v.rule_id == "R304"]
    others = [v for v in must if v.rule_id != "R304"]
    if others:
        shown = "; ".join(f"[{v.rule_id}] {v.path}: {v.message}" for v in others[:SHOWN_IN_WARNING])
        more = f" (+{len(others) - SHOWN_IN_WARNING} more)" if len(others) > SHOWN_IN_WARNING else ""
        warnings.warn(
            f"{where}: {len(others)} MUST violation(s): {shown}{more}; "
            "run `sunstone lint` for all of them; these become errors in sunstone-py 2.0",
            FutureWarning,
            stacklevel=stacklevel,
        )
    if aliases:
        warnings.warn(
            f"{where}: {len(aliases)} deprecated key(s) (e.g. {aliases[0].path}); run `sunstone migrate`; "
            "these become errors in sunstone-py 2.0",
            FutureWarning,
            stacklevel=stacklevel,
        )

    import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from sunstone.datasets import DatasetsManager
from sunstone.lineage import Agent, AgentType, SourceAgent

TESTDATA = Path(__file__).parent / "testdata"


def _load_quiet(path: Path) -> DatasetsManager:
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
        return DatasetsManager(path)


def test_old_and_new_form_parse_to_equal_models() -> None:
    old = _load_quiet(TESTDATA / "UNMembersProject")
    new = _load_quiet(TESTDATA / "UNMembersProjectV2")
    assert old.get_all_inputs() == new.get_all_inputs()
    assert old.get_all_outputs() == new.get_all_outputs()
    assert old.get_package_metadata() == new.get_package_metadata()
    src = new.get_all_inputs()[0].source
    assert src is not None
    assert src.name == "United Nations Member States Authority File"
    assert src.location.data.endswith("member_states_auths_2025-10-08.csv")
    assert src.location.about == "https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4082085"
    assert src.location.metadata.endswith("states.md")
    assert src.attributed_to == "United Nations Dag Hammarskjöld Library"
    assert src.acquired_at == "2025-10-08"
    assert src.acquisition_method == "manual-download"
    assert src.license == "CC-BY-NC-3.0-IGO"


def test_old_form_warns_once_per_file() -> None:
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        DatasetsManager(TESTDATA / "UNMembersProject")
    msgs = [str(x.message) for x in w if x.category is FutureWarning]
    assert sum("sunstone migrate" in m for m in msgs) == 1
    assert sum("MUST violation(s)" in m for m in msgs) == 1, msgs  # R102 (no publisher), R306 ... in one warning
    assert not [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, DeprecationWarning)]

    (tmp_path / "datasets.yaml").write_text("include:\n  - extra.yaml\ninputs:\n  - name: A\n    slug: a\n    location: a.csv\n    bogus: 1\n")
    (tmp_path / "extra.yaml").write_text("outputs:\n  - name: B\n    slug: b\n    location: b.csv\n    other: 1\n")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")

        def _parse_source_location(self, source_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> SourceLocation:
        """Source URLs live directly on the source block as DCAT/RDFS keys."""
        return SourceLocation(
            data=source_data.get("dcat:downloadURL"),
            metadata=source_data.get("rdfs:seeAlso"),
            about=source_data.get("dcat:landingPage"),
            access=source_data.get("dcat:accessURL"),
        )

    def _parse_source(self, source_data: Dict[str, Any], dataset_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Source:
        """Parse a normalized source block; acquisition metadata comes from the dataset."""
        raw_agent = source_data.get("prov:wasAttributedTo")
        attributed_to: str | Agent
        if isinstance(raw_agent, dict):
            attributed_to = Agent(
                id=str(raw_agent.get("@id", raw_agent.get("rdfs:label", ""))),
                type=AgentType(raw_agent.get("@type", "prov:Organization")),
                label=raw_agent.get("rdfs:label"),
                version=source_data.get("version"),
            )
        else:
            attributed_to = "" if raw_agent is None else str(raw_agent)

        generated_by = dataset_data.get("prov:wasGeneratedBy")
        method = generated_by.get("dct:type") if isinstance(generated_by, dict) else None
        acquired = dataset_data.get("prov:generatedAtTime")

        creators = source_data.get("dct:creator")
        creator_list = [a for a in (self._parse_agent(c) for c in creators) if a] if isinstance(creators, list) else None
        is_part_of = source_data.get("dct:isPartOf")
        citation = source_data.get("dct:bibliographicCitation")

        return Source(
            name=str(source_data.get("title", "")),
            location=self._parse_source_location(source_data),
            attributed_to=attributed_to,
            acquired_at=None if acquired is None else str(acquired),
            acquisition_method=None if method is None else str(method),
            license=source_data.get("dct:license"),
            updated=None if source_data.get("dct:modified") is None else str(source_data["dct:modified"]),
            publisher=self._parse_agent(source_data.get("dct:publisher")),
            creator=creator_list or None,
            id=None if source_data.get("@id") is None else str(source_data["@id"]),
            issued=None if source_data.get("dct:issued") is None else str(source_data["dct:issued"]),
            is_part_of=dict(is_part_of) if isinstance(is_part_of, dict) else None,
            bibliographic_citation=None if citation is None else str(citation),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_agent(value: Any) -> Optional[SourceAgent]:
        """An agent object (``rdfs:label``, ``skos:altLabel``, ``"@id"``). Anything else is None (R102 reports it)."""
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or not value.get("rdfs:label"):
            return None
        alt = value.get("skos:altLabel")
        iri = value.get("@id")
        return SourceAgent(label=str(value["rdfs:label"]), alt_label=None if alt is None else str(alt), id=None if iri is None else str(iri))

    def _field_schema_to_dict(field: FieldSchema) -> dict:
    d: dict = {"name": field.name}
    if field.type is not None:
        d["type"] = field.type
    if field.title:
        d["title"] = field.title
    if field.constraints:
        d["constraints"] = field.constraints
    if field.description:
        d["description"] = field.description
    if field.unit:
        d["si:unit"] = field.unit
        if field.unit_source:
            d["qudt:hasUnit"] = field.unit_source
    if field.source:
        d["si:sourceField"] = field.source
    if field.custom_properties:
        for key, value in field.custom_properties.items():
            d[key] = value
    return d

    import json
import shutil
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from typer.testing import CliRunner

from sunstone.cli import app

TESTDATA = Path(__file__).parent / "testdata"
GOLDEN = TESTDATA / "golden" / "un-members.before.json"
PROV = "http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#"
DCT = "http://purl.org/dc/terms/"
DCAT = "http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#"
RDFS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
SKOS = "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#"
SI = "https://sunstone.institute/rdf/vocab#"


def _build(project: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    (project / "outputs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (project / "outputs" / "current_un_member_states.csv").write_text("Country,Code\nTest,TST")
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        r = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["package", "build", "-f", str(project / "datasets.yaml"), "-o", str(project / "datapackage.json")])
    assert r.exit_code == 0, r.output
    return json.loads((project / "datapackage.json").read_text())


def _assert_subset(before: Any, after: Any, path: str = "") -> None:
    if isinstance(before, dict):
        assert isinstance(after, dict), path
        for k, v in before.items():
            assert k in after, f"{path}.{k} removed"
            _assert_subset(v, after[k], f"{path}.{k}")
    elif isinstance(before, list):
        assert isinstance(after, list) and len(after) == len(before), path
        for i, (b, a) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
            _assert_subset(b, a, f"{path}[{i}]")
    else:
        assert before == after, path


def test_no_existing_key_removed_or_changed(project_copy: Path) -> None:
    after = _build(project_copy)
    _assert_subset(json.loads(GOLDEN.read_text()), after)


def test_new_keys_present(project_copy: Path) -> None:
    dp = _build(project_copy)
    assert dp["$schema"] == "https://datapackage.org/profiles/2.0/datapackage.json"
    assert dp["licenses"] == [{"name": "CC-BY-NC-3.0-IGO"}] and dp["license"] == "CC-BY-NC-3.0-IGO"
    src = dp["resources"][0]["sources"][0]
    assert src[f"{PROV}wasAttributedTo"] == "United Nations Dag Hammarskjöld Library"
    assert src[f"{DCT}license"] == "CC-BY-NC-3.0-IGO"
    assert src["http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#seeAlso"].endswith("states.md")
    assert src["path"] == src["http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#downloadURL"]


def test_v2_fixture_builds_identically(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    old = tmp_path / "old"
    new = tmp_path / "new"
    shutil.copytree(TESTDATA / "UNMembersProject", old, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".venv", "uv.lock"))
    shutil.copytree(TESTDATA / "UNMembersProjectV2", new)
    assert _build(old) == _build(new)


def test_conformant_project_fields_and_acquisition(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    proj = tmp_path / "p"
    shutil.copytree(TESTDATA / "ConformantProject", proj)
    yaml_path = proj / "datasets.yaml"
    yaml_path.write_text(yaml_path.read_text().replace("to: gs://example-bucket/conformant/", "to: gs://example-bucket/conformant/\n  as: https://data.example.com/"))
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        r = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["package", "build", "-f", str(yaml_path), "-o", str(proj / "datapackage.json")])
    assert r.exit_code == 0, r.output
    assert not [x for x in w if x.category is FutureWarning and "[R" in str(x.message)]
    dp = json.loads((proj / "datapackage.json").read_text())
    field = next(f for f in dp["resources"][0]["schema"]["fields"] if f["name"] == "area_km2")
    assert field["unit"] == "km**2" and field[f"{SI}unit"] == "km**2"
    assert dp["resources"][0]["path"] == "https://data.example.com/outputs/clean.csv"


def test_structured_source_parts_emitted(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Spec "Source references" as sunstone-cms#610 expects it: expanded keys, agent nodes, path from @id last."""
    proj = tmp_path / "p"

        "      dct:creator:\n        - rdfs:label: Aas, T. S.\n        - rdfs:label: Asgard, T. E.\n"
        "      dct:isPartOf:\n        rdfs:label: Aquaculture Reports 26, 101316\n"
        "      dct:bibliographicCitation: Aas, T. S. & Asgard, T. E. (2022). Test Source. Aquaculture Reports 26, 101316.\n",
    )

    def _expand_value(value: Any, prefixes: dict[str, str]) -> Any:
    from datetime import date, datetime

    def _agent_node(agent: SourceAgent) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Spec "Source references" agent object with expanded keys (sunstone-cms#610 reads these IRIs literally)."""
    node: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if agent.id:
        node["@id"] = agent.id
    node[f"{_RDFS}label"] = agent.label
    if agent.alt_label:
        node[f"{_SKOS}altLabel"] = agent.alt_label
    return node


def _source_entry(source: Source) -> dict[str, Any]:
    entry: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if source.id:
        entry["@id"] = source.id
    entry["title"] = source.name
    loc = source.location
    path = loc.data or loc.about or loc.metadata or loc.access or source.id  # spec: derived, "@id" is the last fallback
    if path:
        entry["path"] = path
    dcat = STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES["dcat"]
    for prop, value in (("downloadURL", loc.data), ("accessURL", loc.access), ("landingPage", loc.about)):
        if value:
            entry[f"{dcat}{prop}"] = value
    if loc.metadata:
        entry[f"{_RDFS}seeAlso"] = loc.metadata
    if source.publisher:
        entry[f"{_DCT}publisher"] = _agent_node(source.publisher)
    if source.creator:
        entry[f"{_DCT}creator"] = [_agent_node(a) for a in source.creator]
    if source.issued:
        entry[f"{_DCT}issued"] = source.issued
    if source.is_part_of:
        entry[f"{_DCT}isPartOf"] = _expand_value(source.is_part_of, STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES)
    if source.bibliographic_citation:
        entry[f"{_DCT}bibliographicCitation"] = source.bibliographic_citation
    agent = source.attributed_to
    if isinstance(agent, Agent):
        node: dict[str, Any] = {"@id": agent.id, "@type": expand_rdf_prefixes(agent.type.value, STANDARD_RDF_PREFIXES)}
        if agent.label:
            node[f"{_RDFS}label"] = agent.label
        entry[f"{_PROV}wasAttributedTo"] = node
        if agent.version:
            entry["version"] = agent.version
    elif agent:
        entry[f"{_PROV}wasAttributedTo"] = str(agent)
    for prop, value in (("license", source.license), ("modified", source.updated)):
        if value:
            entry[f"{_DCT}{prop}"] = value
    return entry

    """Linter for ``datasets.yaml`` against the Sunstone conformance rules.

Rules live in :mod:`sunstone.rules`; checks in :mod:`sunstone.conformance`.
This module loads the files, runs the checks and applies ``lint.disable``
suppressions. Entry point: :func:`lint_project` / ``sunstone lint``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .aliases import make_yaml, normalize_document, normalize_lock
from .conformance import Violation, validate_datasets_yaml, validate_lock
from .rules import RULES, Rule, Severity

__all__ = ["RULES", "Rule", "Severity", "Violation", "LintReport", "lint_project", "report_to_json"]

_yaml = make_yaml()

    LintReport is unchanged. lint_project becomes:

    def lint_project(
    project_path: Path | str,
    *,
    datasets_file: str = "datasets.yaml",
    rules: set[str] | None = None,
) -> LintReport:
    project = Path(project_path).resolve()
    if project.is_file():
        yaml_path = project
        project = project.parent
    else:
        yaml_path = project / datasets_file

    if not yaml_path.exists():
        return LintReport(project_path=project)

    with open(yaml_path, "r") as f:
        data = _yaml.load(f) or {}
    result = normalize_document(data)

    lock_path = project / "datasets.lock.yaml"
    lock_data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    lock_result = None
    if lock_path.exists():
        with open(lock_path, "r") as f:
            lock_data = _yaml.load(f) or {}
        lock_result = normalize_lock(lock_data)

    from .plugins import PluginRegistry

    field_types = PluginRegistry.get(project).field_types.known()

    report = LintReport(project_path=project)
    suppressions, config_violations = _parse_lint_config(data.get("lint"))
    report.suppressions = suppressions

    enabled = (lambda rid: rules is None or rid in rules)

    # R009 violations are NEVER suppressed — that's how we keep lint.disable honest.
    for v in config_violations:
        if enabled(v.rule_id):
            report.add(v)

    violations = validate_datasets_yaml(data, lock=lock_data, field_types=field_types, normalize=False, result=result)
    if lock_result is not None:
        violations += validate_lock(lock_data, data, normalize=False, result=lock_result)

    for v in violations:
        if not enabled(v.rule_id):
            continue
        if v.rule_id in suppressions:
            report.suppressed.append(v)
        else:
            report.add(v)
    return report

    Delete _apply_violation and _LintContext. In _parse_lint_config, construct R009 violations with the conformance dataclass:

    from .rules import Level

def _r009(message: str, location: str, hint: str) -> Violation:
    return Violation("R009", Level.MUST, location, message, hint, Severity.ERROR)

    and replace each Violation(rule_id="R009", severity=..., message=..., location=..., fix_hint=...) with _r009(message, location, hint).

    | Rule | Level | Severity | Description |
|------|-------|----------|-------------|
| R001 | MUST | error | Dataset missing `title` |
| R002 | MUST | error | Dataset missing `name` |
| R003 | MUST | error | Dataset missing `path` |
| R004 | SHOULD | warning | Dataset missing `description` |
| R005 | MUST | error | Dataset missing license (input: `source.dct:license`; output: `licenses`, package `licenses`) |
| R006 | MUST | error | License is not a recognised SPDX or allow-list identifier |
| R007 | MUST | error | Field missing `name` |

| R009 | MUST | error | Malformed `lint.disable` entry (cannot itself be suppressed) |
| R101 | SHOULD | warning | Input missing `source` block |
| R102 | MUST | error | Source missing `title`, `dct:publisher` (with `rdfs:label`), a link (`"@id"`, `dcat:downloadURL` or `dcat:landingPage`) or `dct:license` |
| R103 | SHOULD | warning | Numeric field missing `si:unit` |
| R104 | MUST | error | Dataset `name` not in kebab-case |
| R105 | SHOULD | warning | Published output field missing `description` |
| R201 | INFO | info | Generic field name (`total`, `value`, ...) without a substantive description |
| R202 | INFO | info | Generic dataset title (`data`, `output`, ...) |
| R301 | MUST | error | Key is not a Data Package property, a config key or an RDF property |
| R302 | MUST | error | RDF prefix not declared |
| R303 | MUST | error | Term does not exist in a shipped vocabulary |
| R304 | MUST NOT | warning (1.x) | Deprecated key; run `sunstone migrate` |
| R305 | MUST | error | Dataset has both `slug` and `title` |
| R306 | MUST | error | New-form keys without `min_sunstone_version` >= 1.20.0 |
| R307 | MUST NOT | error | RDF property duplicates a Data Package key or a generated value (`dct:title`, `qudt:unit`, ...) |
| R311 | SHOULD | warning | Source missing `skos:altLabel` on the publisher, `dct:issued` or `dct:modified`; a publication also `dct:creator` and `"@id"` |
| R312 | MUST | error | Input missing `prov:generatedAtTime` or `prov:wasGeneratedBy.dct:type` |
| R313 | MUST | error | Published output has no sources |
| R314 | SHOULD | warning | Published output missing `dct:temporal`, `dct:spatial` or `dcat:theme` |
| R315 | MUST NOT | error | `doi.org` URL in `dcat:downloadURL` or `dcat:landingPage` (a DOI goes in `"@id"`) |
| R321 | SHOULD | warning | Output has no lock entry with sources and activity |
| R322 | MUST | error | Lock source references an unknown dataset |
| R323 | MUST NOT | error | Inline `lineage` in datasets.yaml |
| R331 | MUST | error | Field type not registered |
| R341 | SHOULD | warning | `si:unit` is neither a Pint unit nor a QUDT IRI |
| R351 | MUST | error | Package missing `title` when publishing |
| R361 | SHOULD | warning | No top-level `dcat-si:methodology` (project does not publish) |
| R362 | MUST | error | No top-level `dcat-si:methodology` while publishing a package |

MUST rules are errors (exit non-zero), SHOULD rules are warnings (exit zero unless `--warnings-as-errors`), INFO rules are informational. `--json` output carries `path` and `fix` for every violation.

    import json

import pytest
from typer.testing import CliRunner

from sunstone.cli import app
from sunstone.vocab_search import explain, search


def test_attributed_finds_prov_first() -> None:
    hits = search("attributed")
    assert hits[0].curie == "prov:wasAttributedTo"


def test_multi_word_query_requires_every_word() -> None:
    hits = search("download url")
    assert hits[0].curie == "dcat:downloadURL"
    assert all("download" in (h.curie + h.label + h.definition).lower() for h in hits)


def test_tier_then_source_order() -> None:
    hits = search("title", at="inputs.source")
    assert (hits[0].source, hits[0].curie) == ("dp", "title")
    assert "dct:title" in [h.curie for h in hits]


def test_at_filters_dp_keys_but_not_rdf() -> None:
    assert not [h for h in search("slug") if h.source in ("dp", "config")]
    field_hits = search("name", at="inputs.schema.fields")
    assert ("dp", "name") in {(h.source, h.curie) for h in field_hits}
    assert ("config", "include") not in {(h.source, h.curie) for h in field_hits}
    assert any(h.source == "schema" for h in field_hits)


def test_limit() -> None:
    assert len(search("a", limit=5)) == 5


def test_unknown_path_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        search("x", at="inputs.fields")


def test_explain_fields_level() -> None:
    keys = {k.key: k for k in explain("inputs.schema.fields")}
    assert keys["name"].rule_level == "MUST" and keys["name"].cls == "dp"
    assert keys["type"].rule_level == "MUST"
    assert keys["description"].rule_level == "SHOULD"
    assert keys["si:unit"].rule_level == "SHOULD" and keys["si:unit"].cls == "rdf"
    assert keys["constraints"].rule_level == "MAY"
    assert "slug" not in keys


def test_explain_document_level_lists_config_keys() -> None:
    keys = {k.key: k for k in explain("")}
    assert keys["inputs"].cls == "config" and keys["rdfPrefixes"].cls == "config"
    assert keys["min_sunstone_version"].rule_level == "MUST" and keys["min_sunstone_version"].rule_id == "R306"
    assert keys["dcat-si:methodology"].rule_level == "SHOULD" and keys["dcat-si:methodology"].cls == "rdf"


def test_explain_lists_recommended_properties() -> None:
    keys = {k.key: k for k in explain("outputs")}
    assert keys["dct:temporal"].rule_level == "SHOULD" and keys["dct:temporal"].rule_id == "R314" and keys["dct:temporal"].cls == "rdf"
    assert keys["dcat:keyword"].rule_level == "MAY" and keys["dcat:keyword"].rule_id is None
    assert keys["dct:temporal"].definition  # from dct.json
    field_keys = {k.key: k for k in explain("inputs.schema.fields")}
    assert field_keys["sosa:observedProperty"].rule_level == "MAY"
    source_keys = {k.key: k for k in explain("inputs.source")}
    assert source_keys["dct:publisher"].rule_level == "MUST" and source_keys["dct:publisher"].rule_id == "R102"
    assert source_keys["@id"].rule_level == "MUST" and source_keys["@id"].cls == "jsonld" and "DOI" in source_keys["@id"].definition
    assert source_keys["dct:creator"].rule_level == "SHOULD" and source_keys["dct:issued"].rule_level == "SHOULD"
    assert source_keys["dct:isPartOf"].rule_level == "MAY" and source_keys["dct:bibliographicCitation"].rule_level == "MAY"
    assert source_keys["prov:wasAttributedTo"].rule_level == "MAY"
    assert source_keys["dct:isPartOf"].definition  # from dct.json


def test_search_finds_source_parts() -> None:

    """Linear-scan search over shipped vocabularies and descriptor keys (``sunstone vocab search``)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional

from .conformance import KEY_LEVELS, split_camel
from .rules import Level
from .vocab import Term, all_terms, config_keys, dp_keys, key_definition, level_for_path

SOURCE_ORDER: tuple[str, ...] = ("dp", "config", "dct", "dcat", "prov", "schema", "skos", "rdfs", "qudt", "sosa", "si", "dcat-si")
_RULE_ORDER = {"MUST": 0, "MUST NOT": 0, "SHOULD": 1, "MAY": 2}
_JSONLD_DEFINITIONS = {
    "@id": "JSON-LD identifier of the node. On a source: the DOI as https://doi.org/<doi>, or another persistent IRI.",
    "@type": "JSON-LD type of the node, e.g. prov:Activity.",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class KeyInfo:
    key: str
    cls: str
    level: str
    rule_level: str
    rule_id: Optional[str]
    definition: str


def _match_fields(term: Term) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
    local = term.curie.split(":", 1)[1] if term.iri else term.curie
    return (f"{local} {split_camel(local)}".lower(), term.curie.lower(), term.label.lower(), term.definition.lower())


def _tier(word: str, fields: tuple[str, str, str, str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if word in fields[0] or word in fields[1]:
        return 1
    if word in fields[2]:
        return 2
    if word in fields[3]:
        return 3
    return None


def _resolve_level(at: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if at is None:
        return None
    level = level_for_path(at)
    if level is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown datasets.yaml path: {at!r}")
    return level


def search(query: str, *, at: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 20) -> list[Term]:
    words = query.lower().split()
    level = _resolve_level(at)
    scored: list[tuple[int, int, str, Term]] = []
    for term in all_terms():
        if level is not None and term.source in ("dp", "config") and level not in term.levels:
            continue
        fields = _match_fields(term)
        tiers = [_tier(w, fields) for w in words]
        if not words or any(t is None for t in tiers):
            continue
        best = min(t for t in tiers if t is not None)
        scored.append((best, SOURCE_ORDER.index(term.source), term.curie, term))
    scored.sort(key=lambda s: s[:3])
    return [s[3] for s in scored[:limit]]


def explain(at: str) -> list[KeyInfo]:
    level = _resolve_level(at)
    assert level is not None
    infos: dict[str, KeyInfo] = {}
    for key in dp_keys(level):
        infos[key] = KeyInfo(key, "dp", level, "MAY", None, key_definition(level, key))
    for key in config_keys(level):
        infos[key] = KeyInfo(key, "config", level, "MAY", None, key_definition(level, key))
    for (lvl, key), (rule_level, rule_id) in KEY_LEVELS.items():
        if lvl != level:
            continue
        existing = infos.get(key)
        cls = existing.cls if existing else ("config" if key in config_keys(level) else "jsonld" if key.startswith("@") else "rdf")
        definition = existing.definition if existing else _JSONLD_DEFINITIONS.get(key) or _rdf_definition(key)
        infos[key] = KeyInfo(key, cls, level, rule_level.value, rule_id, definition)
    return sorted(infos.values(), key=lambda k: (_RULE_ORDER[k.rule_level], k.key))


def _rdf_definition(curie: str) -> str:
    for term in all_terms():
        if term.curie == curie and term.iri:
            return term.definition
    return ""


def term_to_dict(term: Term) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "curie": term.curie,
        "iri": term.iri,
        "label": term.label,
        "definition": term.definition,
        "source": term.source,
        "levels": list(term.levels),
    }


def key_info_to_dict(info: KeyInfo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"key": info.key, "class": info.cls, "level": info.level, "rule": info.rule_level, "rule_id": info.rule_id, "definition": info.definition}


__all__ = ["KeyInfo", "SOURCE_ORDER", "explain", "key_info_to_dict", "search", "term_to_dict", "Level"]

    @vocab_app.command("search")
def vocab_search_cmd(
    text: Optional[list[str]] = typer.Argument(None, help="Words to search for (all must match)."),
    at: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--at", help="Restrict DP/config keys to a datasets.yaml path, e.g. inputs.source"),
    limit: int = typer.Option(20, "--limit", help="Maximum number of results."),
    json_output: bool = typer.Option(False, "--json", help="Emit JSON."),
) -> None:
    """Find an RDF term or allowed key. Without TEXT and with --at, list every allowed key at that level."""
    from .vocab_search import explain, key_info_to_dict, search, term_to_dict

    query = " ".join(text or []).strip()
    if not query and at is None:
        typer.echo("Error: give search text, --at <path>, or both.", err=True)
        sys.exit(2)
    try:
        if query:
            hits = search(query, at=at, limit=limit)
            if json_output:
                typer.echo(json.dumps([term_to_dict(t) for t in hits], indent=2))
            else:
                for t in hits:
                    typer.echo(f"{t.curie}  {t.iri or '-'}  {t.label}: {t.definition}")
        else:
            keys = explain(at or "")
            if json_output:
                typer.echo(json.dumps([key_info_to_dict(k) for k in keys], indent=2))
            else:
                for k in keys:
                    typer.echo(f"{k.key}  {k.cls}  {k.rule_level}  {k.definition}")
    except ValueError as e:
        typer.echo(f"Error: {e}", err=True)
        sys.exit(2)

    """``sunstone migrate``: rewrite datasets.yaml, its include files and datasets.lock.yaml to the new key form."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .aliases import NormalizeResult, ensure_min_version, make_yaml, normalize_document, normalize_lock
from .conformance import split_camel, validate_datasets_yaml

LOCK_HEADER = "# Auto-generated by sunstone. Do not edit manually.\n"
_ARRAY_RE = re.compile(r"\[\d+\]")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UnknownKey:
    path: str
    key: str
    suggestions: list[str]


@dataclass
class MigrationReport:
    changed: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    unknown: list[UnknownKey] = field(default_factory=list)
    dry_run: bool = False


def _write(path: Path, data: Any, *, header: str = "") -> None:
    yaml = make_yaml()
    ca = getattr(data, "ca", None)
    if header and ca is not None:
        ca.comment = None
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        if header:
            f.write(header)
        yaml.dump(data, f)


def _suggest(key: str, path: str) -> list[str]:
    from .vocab import level_for_path
    from .vocab_search import search

    at = _ARRAY_RE.sub("", path)
    at = at if level_for_path(at) is not None else None
    return [t.curie for t in search(split_camel(key), at=at, limit=3)]


def migrate_project(project_path: Path | str, *, datasets_file: str = "datasets.yaml", dry_run: bool = False) -> MigrationReport:
    project = Path(project_path).resolve()
    main_path = project / datasets_file
    yaml = make_yaml()
    report = MigrationReport(dry_run=dry_run)

    with open(main_path, "r") as f:
        main = yaml.load(f) or {}
    main_result = normalize_document(main)
    main_changes = len(main_result.renames)
    if (main_result.renames or main_result.new_form) and ensure_min_version(main):
        main_changes += 1
    if main_changes:
        report.changed[main_path.name] = main_changes
        if not dry_run:
            _write(main_path, main)

    for rel in main.get("include") or []:
        inc_path = (main_path.parent / str(rel)).resolve()
        if not inc_path.exists():
            continue
        with open(inc_path, "r") as f:
            inc = yaml.load(f) or {}
        inc_result = normalize_document(inc)
        if inc_result.renames:
            report.changed[Path(str(rel)).as_posix()] = len(inc_result.renames)
            if not dry_run:
                _write(inc_path, inc)

    lock_path = main_path.parent / "datasets.lock.yaml"
    if lock_path.exists():
        with open(lock_path, "r") as f:
            lock = yaml.load(f) or {}
        lock_result = normalize_lock(lock)
        if lock_result.renames:
            report.changed[lock_path.name] = len(lock_result.renames)
            if not dry_run:
                _write(lock_path, lock, header=LOCK_HEADER)

    for v in validate_datasets_yaml(main, normalize=False, result=NormalizeResult()):
        if v.rule_id != "R301":
            continue
        container, _, key = v.path.rpartition(".")
        report.unknown.append(UnknownKey(v.path, key, _suggest(key, container)))
    return report
    • [ ] Step 4: Add the CLI command in src/sunstone/cli.py (top level, after lint_cmd)
    @app.command("migrate")
def migrate_cmd(
    datasets_file: str = typer.Option("datasets.yaml", "-f", "--file", help="Path to datasets.yaml"),
    dry_run: bool = typer.Option(False, "--dry-run", help="Report what would change without writing."),
) -> None:
    """Rewrite datasets.yaml, its include files and datasets.lock.yaml to the current key names.

    Comments and key order are kept. Safe to run repeatedly. Keys that are neither
    Data Package properties, config keys nor RDF properties are listed with suggestions.
    """
    from .migrate import migrate_project

    yaml_path = Path(datasets_file).resolve()
    if not yaml_path.exists():
        typer.echo(f"Error: {datasets_file} not found", err=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    report = migrate_project(yaml_path.parent, datasets_file=yaml_path.name, dry_run=dry_run)
    verb = "would rename" if dry_run else "renamed"
    if not report.changed:
        typer.echo("Nothing to migrate.")
    for name, count in report.changed.items():
        typer.echo(f"{name}: {count} key(s) {verb}")
    if report.unknown:
        typer.echo("Unknown keys (not DP, config or RDF):")
        for u in report.unknown:
            hint = ", ".join(u.suggestions) if u.suggestions else "no suggestion"
            typer.echo(f"  {u.path}: try {hint}")
    typer.echo("Run `sunstone lint` to review remaining findings.")

    """Render JSON Schemas and the key reference from the vocabulary data. Run via scripts/gen_schemas.py."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from . import DP_PROFILE_URL, aliases, config_keys, dp_keys, key_definition, legacy_emitted_keys, level_children

SCHEMA_BASE = "https://sunstoneinstitute.github.io/sunstone-py/schemas/"
RDF_KEY_PATTERNS: dict[str, Any] = {"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[^\\s]+$": {}, "^https?://": {}}
ARRAY_KEYS = frozenset({"inputs", "outputs", "packages", "contributors", "sources", "licenses", "fields", "resources"})
YAML_LEVELS = ("document", "dataset", "source", "schema", "field", "constraints", "license", "dialect", "package", "contributor", "publish", "lint", "defaults", "node")
DP_LEVELS = ("package", "resource", "source", "schema", "field", "constraints", "license", "dialect", "contributor", "node")
LEVEL_PATHS = {
    "document": ".", "dataset": "inputs / outputs", "source": "inputs.source", "schema": "inputs.schema",
    "field": "inputs.schema.fields", "constraints": "inputs.schema.fields.constraints", "license": "inputs.licenses / package.licenses",
    "dialect": "inputs.dialect", "package": "package / packages", "contributor": "package.contributors",
    "publish": "publish", "lint": "lint", "defaults": "defaults", "node": "<any RDF property object value>",
}
EXAMPLES: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {
    ("document", "include"): "include: [data/extra.yaml]",
    ("document", "rdfPrefixes"): "rdfPrefixes: {ex: https://example.org/ns#}",
    ("document", "min_sunstone_version"): 'min_sunstone_version: "1.20.0"',
    ("document", "dcat-si:methodology"): "dcat-si:methodology: METHODOLOGY.md",
    ("dataset", "dct:temporal"): "dct:temporal: '2020/2024'",
    ("dataset", "dct:spatial"): "dct:spatial: Norway",
    ("dataset", "dcat:theme"): "dcat:theme: https://sunstone.institute/rdf/threats#01",
    ("dataset", "dcat:keyword"): "dcat:keyword: [aquaculture, salmon]",
    ("field", "sosa:observedProperty"): "sosa:observedProperty: http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/Temperature",
    ("field", "qudt:hasQuantityKind"): "qudt:hasQuantityKind: http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/Area",
    ("dataset", "title"): "title: Official UN Member States",
    ("dataset", "name"): "name: un-member-states",
    ("dataset", "path"): "path: inputs/un_members.csv",
    ("dataset", "description"): "description: One row per member state.",
    ("dataset", "licenses"): "licenses: [{name: CC-BY-4.0}]",
    ("dataset", "source"): "source: {title: ..., dcat:downloadURL: ...}",
    ("dataset", "schema"): "schema: {fields: [...], primaryKey: id}",
    ("dataset", "prov:generatedAtTime"): "prov:generatedAtTime: '2026-01-02'",
    ("dataset", "prov:wasGeneratedBy"): "prov:wasGeneratedBy: {'@type': prov:Activity, dct:type: manual-download}",
    ("source", "@id"): '"@id": https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aqrep.2022.101316',
    ("source", "title"): "title: UN Member States Authority File",
    ("source", "dcat:downloadURL"): "dcat:downloadURL: https://example.org/data.csv",
    ("source", "dcat:landingPage"): "dcat:landingPage: https://example.org/about",
    ("source", "dct:publisher"): "dct:publisher: {rdfs:label: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, skos:altLabel: FAO}",
    ("source", "dct:creator"): "dct:creator: [{rdfs:label: 'Aas, T. S.'}, {rdfs:label: 'Asgard, T. E.'}]",
    ("source", "dct:issued"): "dct:issued: '2022'",

    ("source", "dct:bibliographicCitation"): "dct:bibliographicCitation: 'Aas, T. S. & Asgard, T. E. (2022). Title. Aquaculture Reports 26.'",
    ("source", "prov:wasAttributedTo"): "prov:wasAttributedTo: 'Aas, T. S.; Asgard, T. E. (Nofima); published by Elsevier'",
    ("source", "dct:license"): "dct:license: CC-BY-4.0",

def _level_schema(level: str, keys: set[str], defs_available: set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    props: dict[str, Any] = {}
    children = level_children(level)
    for key in sorted(keys):
        child = children.get(key)
        if child in defs_available:
            ref = {"$ref": f"#/definitions/{child}"}
            props[key] = {"type": "array", "items": ref} if key in ARRAY_KEYS else ref
        else:
            props[key] = {}
    out: dict[str, Any] = {"type": "object", "properties": props, "patternProperties": dict(RDF_KEY_PATTERNS), "additionalProperties": False}
    if level == "node":
        out["properties"] = {"@id": {"type": "string"}, "@type": {"type": "string"}}
    return out


def render_datasets_schema() -> dict[str, Any]:
    levels = set(YAML_LEVELS)
    defs = {lvl: _level_schema(lvl, set(dp_keys(lvl)) | set(config_keys(lvl)), levels) for lvl in YAML_LEVELS}
    return {
        "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
        "$id": SCHEMA_BASE + "datasets.schema.json",
        "title": "sunstone datasets.yaml",
        "description": "Keys are Data Package 2.0 properties, sunstone config keys, or RDF properties (prefix:local or IRI).",
        "$ref": "#/definitions/document",
        "definitions": defs,
    }


def render_datapackage_profile() -> dict[str, Any]:
    levels = set(DP_LEVELS)
    defs = {lvl: _level_schema(lvl, set(dp_keys(lvl)) | set(legacy_emitted_keys(lvl)), levels) for lvl in DP_LEVELS}
    return {
        "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
        "$id": SCHEMA_BASE + "datapackage-profile.json",
        "title": "sunstone Data Package profile",
        "description": f"Data Package 2.0 ({DP_PROFILE_URL}) with extras restricted to prefixed names or IRIs.",
        "$ref": "#/definitions/package",
        "definitions": defs,
    }


def render_reference_md() -> str:
    from ..rules import RULES
    from ..vocab_search import explain

    lines = [
        "# datasets.yaml key reference",
        "",
        "Generated by `scripts/gen_schemas.py` from `src/sunstone/vocab/`. Do not edit by hand.",
        "",
        "Every key is one of: a Data Package 2.0 property (`dp`) for its level, a sunstone config key (`config`), or an RDF property (`rdf`: `prefix:local` or an absolute IRI). RDF properties are allowed at every level; the rows marked `rdf` below are the ones a rule asks for. Rule levels follow RFC 2119 (`MUST`, `SHOULD`, `MAY`).",
        "",
        "Editor support: add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=" + SCHEMA_BASE + "datasets.schema.json` as the first line of `datasets.yaml`.",
        "",
        "Agent objects (`dct:publisher`, each `dct:creator` entry) carry `rdfs:label` (full name), optional `skos:altLabel` (short name) and optional `\"@id\"` (IRI). Repeat an agent within one file with a YAML anchor: `dct:publisher: &fao {rdfs:label: ..., skos:altLabel: FAO}` on first use, `dct:publisher: *fao` after. Anchors do not cross include files.",
        "",
    ]
    for level in YAML_LEVELS:
        if level in ("node",):
            continue
        lines += [f"## {level.capitalize()}", "", f"Path: `{LEVEL_PATHS[level]}`", "", "| Key | Class | Rule | Description | Example |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
        for info in explain(_example_path(level)):
            example = EXAMPLES.get((level, info.key), f"{info.key}: ...")
            lines.append(f"| `{info.key}` | {info.cls} | {info.rule_level} | {info.definition} | `{example}` |")
        lines.append("")
    lines += ["## Aliases (old key to new key)", "", "| Level | Old | New |", "|---|---|---|"]
    for level, entries in aliases().items():
        for e in entries:
            lines.append(f"| {level} | `{e['old']}` | `{e['new']}` |")
    lines += ["", "## Rules", "", "| Rule | Level | Category | Title |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
    for rule in RULES.values():
        lines.append(f"| {rule.id} | {rule.level.value} | {rule.category.value} | {rule.title} |")
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _example_path(level: str) -> str:
    return {
        "document": "", "dataset": "inputs", "source": "inputs.source", "schema": "inputs.schema", "field": "inputs.schema.fields",
        "constraints": "inputs.schema.fields.constraints", "license": "inputs.licenses", "dialect": "inputs.dialect",
        "package": "package", "contributor": "package.contributors", "publish": "publish", "lint": "lint", "defaults": "defaults",
    }[level]


def write_all(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    import json

    out = [
        (root / "schemas" / "datasets.schema.json", json.dumps(render_datasets_schema(), indent=2) + "\n"),
        (root / "schemas" / "datapackage-profile.json", json.dumps(render_datapackage_profile(), indent=2) + "\n"),
        (root / "docs" / "datasets-yaml-reference.md", render_reference_md()),
    ]
    for path, text in out:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return [p for p, _ in out]

    ## [Unreleased]

- Added: `sunstone migrate` rewrites `datasets.yaml`, include files and the lock file to Data Package 2.0 key names.
- Added: `sunstone vocab search` finds RDF terms and allowed keys; `--at <path>` lists every key allowed at a level.
- Added: lint rules R301–R362 for unknown keys, duplicate RDF properties, provenance, lineage, field types, units, naming and methodology; `--json` includes `path` and `fix`.
- Added: `datapackage.json` sets `$schema` to the DP 2.0 profile and emits provenance and methodology as expanded IRIs.
- Added: generated `schemas/datasets.schema.json` for editor validation and `docs/datasets-yaml-reference.md`.
- Added: `sosa` and `dcat-si` are shipped vocabularies; `dcat-si` is a standard prefix.
- Added: structured source references (`"@id"` DOI, `dct:publisher`/`dct:creator` agent objects, `dct:issued`, `dct:isPartOf`, `dct:bibliographicCitation`) in `datasets.yaml` and `datapackage.json`.
- Changed: a source must carry `title`, a `dct:publisher` object, a link (`"@id"`, `dcat:downloadURL` or `dcat:landingPage`) and `dct:license`; `prov:wasAttributedTo` is optional.
- Changed: `sunstone migrate` moves a `doi.org` URL from `location.*` to the source `"@id"` and wraps a string `dct:publisher` into an agent object.
- Changed: `datasets.yaml` uses DP names (`title`, `name`, `path`, `schema.fields`, `licenses`) and RDF keys on sources and fields; old keys still load with one `FutureWarning` per file and are written back in the new form on the next save.
- Changed: files in the new key form must set `min_sunstone_version` to 1.20.0 or higher; every write does this automatically.
- Changed: R004 (missing description) is a warning; R102 (source keys) and R104 (kebab-case name) are errors.
